description: This file implements a FastAPI router for managing user file uploads, downloads, listing, and deletions. It interfaces with Supabase for storage and database operations, handles file validation, and enforces access control via user dependencies and RLS policies.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates a Supabase client using environment variables.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Returns the file extension in lowercase from a filename.

methods.name: list_files( session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Lists files for the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles uploading a file, validating type and size, storing in Supabase Storage, and inserting metadata.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes a specific file owned by the user, removing both storage object and metadata.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes a file associated with a specific session, ensuring ownership.

ctags.name: delete_file
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None):$/

ctags.name: delete_session_file
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: /
ctags.signature: (session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)

ctags.name: list_files
ctags.signature: ( session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )

ctags.signature: ( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
